implementation: Phase 1 - CI: inventory every existing validation command, then create required blocking jobs for type checking, lint, unit and contract tests, PostgreSQL and object-storage integration, product browser tests, accessibility, security, deployment packaging, migrations and completeness; use disposable fixtures and retain named evidence artifacts

Phase 6 - operational response: translate the checked-in dashboard and alert contracts into the selected staging collector and notification route, name the responsible owner, link each notification to its runbook, and prove at least one end-to-end alert delivery; checked-in JSON alone is not alert delivery
